answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission. The ridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The tide lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the comet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
